scope: Researched water-activity area references for the current catalog. Geographic matches do not certify exact operator launch points, coral plots, licenses, weather safety, or entire routes.

land_validation.method: Point-in-polygon against connected OpenStreetMap coastline ways with inland closures; limited to explicit coverage bounds. Distances use a local equirectangular metric approximation.

marine_grid_check.note: All nine water references returned wave data. The returned marine model grid can be many kilometres away; it does not validate the requested point as water or establish a local safe operating zone. This is an audit snapshot, not a runtime forecast.

sources.supports: Existing service names, activity descriptions and locations; not an operator confirmation.

Man Thai departure; morning Hon Sup paddle and afternoon nearshore activity. The selected point is a nearshore reference, not the whole morning route.
